source.snippet: Former front-end web developer/vibe coder here. I've started using AI tools to streamline my workflow. I'm now able to create marketing websites in under 2 hours and charge $1k-$2k per site. My hourly earnings have increased to around $1k USD. (7 points, 14 comments, June 2026)

problem_statement: Freelance web developers using AI tools can now produce marketing websites in under 2 hours but lack a standardized workflow, productized service packaging, or client-facing delivery system to repeatably operate at this throughput and price point without custom quoting and scoping every engagement.
target_segment: Freelance web developers and small dev shops adopting AI-assisted development to productize high-volume website delivery
notes: Buyer signal is indirect: the poster is the seller, not the buyer, earning $1k-$2k per site. However, 14 comments and 7 points suggest the community is engaging with the model. The underlying pain for a product opportunity is on the freelancer side — they need tooling to systematize quoting, scoping, client onboarding, and delivery for high-volume AI-generated sites. Signal strength is modest (single post, success story framing rather than explicit pain), but buyer willingness-to-pay is evidenced by clients paying $1k-$2k per site.
